name: Loaded Baked Potato Bowl (Strictly No Skins)
whyItWorks: Peeled russet, Yukon gold, or sweet potatoes provide soluble potassium and soothing starch without roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or microwave potato until tender, scoop out the inside (discard the fibrous skin), and mash with butter, lactose-free sour cream, melted sharp cheddar, and browned ground turkey.
